transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Okay, I think we have everyone except Lukas. Let's get started, I'd like to keep this to under an hour if we can.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Sounds good. Beth, can you start with the overall picture?

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Sure. To restate, the goal today is a round of updates by workstream, then the schedule changes, then risks. Actuators first. Arjun?

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: ok so, uh, actuator DVT builds are going fine. dyno is the bottleneck, we've got one rig and everyone wants it

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: We are working on a second rig, but the torque transducer mount is not done!!

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: yeah that. also the thermal numbers are better with the heat spreader, firmware derate is the backstop

transcript.speaker: p-jonas
transcript.text: derate is in the branch, needs testing on the dyno

transcript.speaker: p-farah
transcript.text: On the electrical side, 1. the driver board respin is back from assembly, 2. we are validating the bus load with all legs streaming, 3. no new issues on the power board. I think the biggest risk is still the CAN loading.

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Legs, I'll go through three points. First, the drop test fixture is mostly set up. Second, the harness is the long pole for the leg builds. Third, the gait gantry first steps are blocked on instrumentation.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Priya, is the harness a vendor issue or ours?

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Mostly vendor lead time, not 100% sure on the rest.

transcript.speaker: p-gwen
transcript.text: I can look at that with Samir after this. We have a couple of open quotes.

transcript.speaker: p-sofia
transcript.text: Hands and wrist, the wrist prototype passed the first fatigue pass. We are cutting a revision for the finger link, nothing blocking.

transcript.speaker: p-omar
transcript.text: i think the program rollup shows us roughly on track except for legs, probably

transcript.speaker: p-nora
transcript.text: From manufacturing, we have a lot of orders sitting in DFM review. I will send a note about what we hold up on.

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: sorry, late. what did i miss

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Just updates, Lukas. We are about to cover the schedule.

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Okay, schedule. Leg DVT build moved to 11/4. That was driven by the harness and the drop test fixture.

transcript.speaker: p-priya
transcript.text: Right, and it assumes the harness lands in time.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Understood. Any more movement behind that?

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: Not on the leg side. Dmitri, test schedule?

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Test is gated by fixtures, same as always. The rig is the whole thing.

transcript.speaker: p-lukas
transcript.text: structures frame is on schedule, we have the shin links done

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Good. Let's move on to the risks.

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: One more schedule item. Hip actuator thermal derate at continuous torque is now 10/12. Arjun, that's the test result date?

transcript.speaker: p-arjun
transcript.text: yeah, 10/12 is when we expect to have the numbers, i mean we need the dyno slot

transcript.speaker: p-dmitri
transcript.text: Dyno is yours that week, I will block it.

transcript.speaker: p-ingrid
transcript.text: Okay. Anything else? Thanks everyone.

transcript.speaker: p-beth
transcript.text: I'll send notes. Thanks.

summary.overview: Hardware program review, round of updates by workstream followed by schedule changes and risks. Legs and test fixtures are gating, actuator thermal work in progress.
shorthand_bullet: Actuators: DVT builds ok, single dyno rig is bottleneck, heat spreader improves thermals, firmware derate backstop
Electrical: driver respin back, CAN bus loading still biggest risk
Legs: drop test fixture mostly set up, harness long pole, gantry blocked on instrumentation
Hands: wrist passed first fatigue pass, finger link revision
Hip actuator thermal derate at continuous torque now 10/12
Manufacturing: orders sitting in DFM review
action_items: Gwen/Samir to look at harness lead time quotes
Nora to send note on DFM holds
